subject: Weekly: security evidence sprint — SOC 2 / DPA / pen test items
messages:

Subject: Evidence sprint kickoff / weekly checkpoint

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the call last week. As we agreed, Acme needs a weekly checkpoint while we pull together the items for SOC 2, finalize DPA redlines, and scope the pen test. Attached is our current MAP (acme_map_v1.pdf) and a short list of initial asks from our side. Top priorities for us right now:

- SOC 2: system inventory, retention settings, and audit log examples (we need to see the formats)
- DPA: a few redlines around data subprocessing and deletion timelines
- Pen test: preferred windows and a list of public IPs/hostnames for in-scope systems

Can we run a 30-min weekly sync? Prefer morning PT; Thursday works best for our security team. A couple of questions up front: do you have a single place we should upload evidence, and who will be the owner for each bucket?

Thanks,

Jillian Park
Senior Security Manager, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

Attachments: acme_map_v1.pdf (pdf)

Jillian — thanks, got the MAP and the ask list. Short answers up front:

- Single upload: we prefer a Drive folder (link below) with a short filename convention (ACME_<item>_<owner>). I created a folder and shared it with your security alias.
- Owners (internal): Mina — SOC 2 evidence collection; Neha — DPA redlines & legal coordination; Ethan — pen test coordination and vendor logistics; Marissa — overall MAP cadence and procurement items. If that allocation looks good, we'll stick to it.

I've attached a SOC2-readiness-matrix.xlsx and a pen-test-ask-list.md that map our internal tasks to your asks. Proposed weekly sync: Thursdays 9:30 AM PT (starting 2027-03-18). If that works for your team, we'll send a recurring invite.

Action items I propose in this thread (first pass):
- MINA: Populate matrix with current evidence links and ETA for missing items (system inventory, audit log samples) — due Tue 2027-03-22.
- NEHA: Review Acme DPA redlines and return consolidated comments — due Fri 2027-03-19.
- ETHAN: Confirm pen test vendor window and request IP ranges from Acme — due Wed 2027-03-17.
- MARISSA: Confirm procurement checklist and share DocuSign link for the SOW once terms agreed.

If anyone needs to reshuffle owners, flag here.

thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Thanks Karthik — quick status from SOC 2 side. I'm attaching an exported list of evidence items we've already collected and the ones still pending. Snapshot:

- Collected:
  - System inventory (partial, needs app owner verification) — link in Drive
  - Retention config for embeddings and logs — exported config snippets attached
  - Access control screenshots for admin console (last 90 days) — collected

- Pending / blockers:
  - Audit log samples for token-level events (we need to pull a 7-day window and scrub PII) — ETA 2027-03-22 (owner: Mina).
  - Penetration test scoping artifacts (we need Acme to confirm test IPs and allowed hours).
  - Encryption KMS rotation proof for east region (gathering with infra).

I've started filling the SOC2-readiness-matrix.xlsx and added direct links to each evidence file in the shared folder. For the audit logs, I'll create redacted samples and place them in the Drive under ACME_auditlogs_Mina_20270322.zip (stubbed entry).

Forwarding the relevant extract from Karthik's note below for context.

— Mina Haddad

- Week of 2027-03-29: light reconnaissance and daytime testing (09:00-17:00 PT)
- Week of 2027-04-05: full-day testing (with night shift allowed if agreed)
